title: hieracium caesium
intro: Hieracium caesium, commonly known as the meadow saw-wort, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium caesium include its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit antibacterial properties, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium caesium include sesquiterpene lactones, such as alantolactone and isoalantolactone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
